name: party-games
description: 多人在线聚会小游戏合集（网页版，手机/电脑浏览器均可玩）

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @party-games/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @party-games/server" "npm run dev -w @party-games/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @party-games/shared && npm run build -w @party-games/client && npm run build -w @party-games/server
scripts.test: npm run build -w @party-games/shared && npm run build -w @party-games/server && node tests/run-all.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.preview: npm run build && npm run start -w @party-games/server
